data.long_meaning: Ashwell is an Old English name derived from the words ‘ase’ (ash tree) and ‘well’ (valley, spring). This name was given to children born near an ash tree growing by a spring or a valley filled with ash trees. The name Ashwell carries the meaning “Ash tree valley” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ashwell usually hope their child will grow to embody ash tree valley and live with faith, good character and purpose.
